Coram : R.K. AGRAWAL*, ASHOK BHUSHAN
Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 - s.438 - Anticipatory bail granted to the respondents accused of commission of offence u!ss.323, 354 and 452 !PC and s.3(1){xi) of SC/ST Act -Appeal by complainant - Held: s.438 of the Code is not available in respect of offences under the SC/ST Act - Offences Act fall into a separate and special class - High Court committed grave error in granting anticipatory bail lo respondents - Constitution of India - Art.17 - Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 - s.3(/)(xi). Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes
